## What this changes

Say what changed and why. Name the issue, for example `Refs #12`.

## Checklist

* [ ] I edited the files in `src/` or the snippets, not `theme.css`, and ran `./build.sh`.
* [ ] `make all` passes.
* [ ] A new variable has a value that I looked at in Obsidian, or the pull request says that I did not.
* [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased if the change is visible.
